The '''fissure sleeper''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]]<ref name="Item" /> native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Encounter" /> They spent the majority of their lives in the deep dark, feeding off of [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic fissures]],<ref name="Item" /> and almost never ventured into shallow enough waters to be caught by a fisherman.<ref name="Encounter" /> Their flesh was one of the rarest delicacies in [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] culture, however if not prepared carefully they were lethal when eaten.<ref name="Item" />
